title: Google Cloud AI DevOps Engineer

bulletPoints: Work on Cutting-Edge AI & Cloud Technologies
Collaborative, High-Impact Role with Career Growth
content.jobHook: Hiring Google Cloud AI DevOps Engineer Australia/New Zealand!
content.unEditedContent:
We are HCLTech, one of the fastest-growing large tech companies in the world and home to 219,000+ people across 54 countries, supercharging progress through industry-leading capabilities centered around Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Google Cloud AI DevOps Engineer to design, build, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure and automated deployment pipelines on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role combines deep expertise in cloud engineering, DevOps practices, and AI/ML platform enablement to support data-driven and AI-powered solutions.

The successful candidate will work closely with Data Science, Platform Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to deliver secure, reliable, and highly available GCP-based environments while driving automation, efficiency, and continuous improvement.


 Key Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and maintain automated build and deployment pipelines using GCP services such as Cloud Build, Cloud Functions, GKE, and GCE.

- Develop and manage infrastructure using IaC tools (Terraform, Cloud Deploy, Cloud Build, Jenkins, Packer, Terragrunt) to ensure consistent and scalable deployments.

- Create and optimize container images and manage container registries.

- Integrate and manage DevOps tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, ArgoCD, and Tekton.

- Implement monitoring and logging using Cloud Operations, Prometheus, and Grafana.

- Apply automation and security best practices ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and compliance.

- Manage source control repositories (GitHub, Bitbucket) including branching, code reviews, and releases.

- Provide technical guidance, documentation, and best-practice enablement.

 

Skill Requirements

Required Skills & Expertise

- Experience building pipelines and infrastructure on GCP using tools such as Vertex AI, GKE, Cloud Build, and Cloud Functions.

- Expertise in DevOps methodologies and CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, ArgoCD, Tekton).

- Deep knowledge of Docker, Dockerfiles, and container registries.

- Hands-on experience with Terraform, Deployment Manager, and scripting (Python, Bash).

- Strong Git-based workflow experience.

- Monitoring/logging experience using Cloud Operations, Prometheus, Grafana.

- Strong collaboration skills with data science and platform engineering teams.

- Understanding of cloud security, IAM, and governance.

- Experience tuning and scaling AI workloads on GCP.

- Preferred: Google Cloud DevOps or AI Engineer certifications.


Qualifications & Certifications

- Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or a related field; MBA/management qualification is a plus.

- GCP Professional DevOps Engineer certification (required).

- GCP Professional Cloud Architect certification (preferred).

- Terraform Associate certification.


 Why HCL

  • We are one of the fastest-growing large tech companies in the world, with offices in 50+ countries across the globe and 219,000 employees.

  • Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented.

  • We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues across the globe.

  • We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good work-life integration and real flexibility.

  • We offer comprehensive benefits for all employees.

  • We are a certified great place to work and a top employer in 17 countries, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect


How to apply:

To apply for this role, you should have a full work right to work in Australia. Press "Apply now" button to submit your resume or send your updated CV to: priyanka_ku@hcltech.com

HCL's enlightened approach to employee development focus on giving people whatever they need to succeed: be it a virtual assistant or talent transformation sabbaticals; expert guidance or fast track growth; inner peace or democratic empowerment.

Candidate Data Privacy Notice | HCL Technologies

We are committed to respecting your privacy and for the protection of your personal data. Your personal data will be collected and processed in line with our candidate privacy notice: https://www.hcltech.com/candidate-privacy-notice. This privacy notice will help you to understand what personal data we collect about you, how we use this personal data, and what rights you have regarding your personal data. By replying to this email or submitting any personal data to HCLTech, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the candidate privacy notice and have provided your consent to the processing of your data for recruitment purposes as described in the privacy notice

title: Senior Software Engineer – AI & Innovation (.NET, Python & Azure)

bulletPoints: Work nationally with hybrid working arrangements
Build innovative solutions using C#, .NET, Python, Azure and AI
content.jobHook: Exclusive access to coworking spaces, membership to our corporate benefits program and transparent agency fees.
content.unEditedContent:
• 12 + 12 + 12-month with a key Commonwealth Government agency
  • Positions available nationally across the ACT, NSW, VIC, QLD, SA and WA
  • Work at the forefront of innovation within a large Commonwealth Government environment
  • Applicants must hold, or be eligible to obtain, a Baseline security clearance
Resolve Recruit is partnering with a leading Commonwealth Government agency to find experienced and highly skilled Senior Software Engineers – Innovation.

This is a hands-on role for engineers who enjoy working at the front edge of a large enterprise: researching emerging technologies, building proof-of-concepts and rapid prototypes, and then transforming successful ideas into secure, scalable and enterprise-ready capabilities.

You will design, develop, test and support innovative digital solutions aligned with strategic priorities. Working across C#, .NET, Python, Azure and AI technologies, you will balance rapid experimentation with the architecture, security, governance and operational requirements of a major government environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, test and support innovative digital solutions, prototypes and technology capabilities
  • Research, evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, AI capabilities, engineering practices and innovative delivery approaches
  • Build proof-of-concepts and rapid prototypes to test technical hypotheses, demonstrate business value and support investment decisions
  • Translate successful prototypes and experimental solutions into secure, scalable, maintainable and enterprise-ready capabilities
  • Develop C# and .NET web applications and APIs
  • Use Python to develop AI and machine-learning solutions, prototypes and web applications
  • Design and automate Azure environments using Infrastructure as Code and Terraform
  • Ensure solutions comply with enterprise architecture, security, scalability, supportability and governance requirements
  • Work collaboratively with architects, engineers, delivery teams and business stakeholders
  • Develop reusable technical patterns, components, libraries, frameworks, standards and processes
  • Balance rapid delivery and experimentation with enterprise reliability and risk-management considerations
  • Contribute to capability uplift through mentoring, knowledge sharing and technical documentation
  • Capture technical learnings and embed them into reusable assets, guidance and platform capabilities
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, experimentation and improvement
Key Experience and Skills

To be successful, you will demonstrate experience across the following areas:
  • C# and .NET web applications and APIs
  • Python development for AI/ML, rapid prototyping and web frameworks
  • Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code and Terraform
  • Establishing reusable engineering patterns that support enterprise capability
  • Applying AI and machine-learning software practices to specific business problems or operational challenges
  • Government or large-enterprise IT design and delivery
  • Building secure, scalable and maintainable software solutions
  • Working collaboratively across multidisciplinary technical and business teams
Experience with comparable or analogous technologies will also be considered where you can clearly explain how your experience relates to the role.

Candidates should also demonstrate a genuine interest in AI, innovation and emerging technologies. Relevant experience may have been gained through professional roles, start-up environments, personal or side projects, self-directed learning, open-source contributions, published research, hackathons or innovation challenges.

A demonstrated understanding of responsible AI and AI safety principles will be highly regarded.

Security Requirements

Applicants must hold, or be eligible to obtain, a Baseline security clearance. 

Work Arrangements

The roles can be performed nationally from approved locations in the ACT, NSW, VIC, QLD, SA and WA.

Alternative flexible working arrangements, including additional remote work, may be considered on a case-by-case basis, subject to business requirements and the needs of the team.

How to Apply

If you are an experienced software engineer who enjoys exploring emerging technologies and transforming promising ideas into practical enterprise capabilities, we would love to hear from you.

Apply by Wednesday, 5 August 2026. Applications received after the deadline may still be considered for future opportunities

For further information or to discuss this opportunity, please email hello@resolve-recruit.com.au, quoting job ID: 37273.

Why Choose Resolve?
  • Expert recruitment consultants committed to advancing your career.
  • A transparent and fair fee structure, offering you peace of mind and trust at every step.
  • Flexible contracting models to suit your specific needs.
  • Complimentary payroll management and tax compliance services, supported by our expertise as a Chartered Accounting firm and Registered Tax Agents.
  • Exclusive access to membership privileges at collaborative co-working spaces, fostering networking and innovation.
  • A variety of pay cycle options designed for financial convenience and flexibility.
  • Access to corporate benefits programs, enhancing both your professional and personal life.

content.jobHook: DevSecOps Specialist w/ 2-4 years' experience securing & automating AI/ML pipelines, integrating security into CI/CD,& enabling reliable AI operations
content.unEditedContent:
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Find out more about us at accenture.com.

Group Description: We are looking for a DevSecOps Specialist with expertise in securing and automating AI/ML pipelines. In this role, you will ensure that our AI/ML systems are deployed securely and reliably, integrating robust security measures into CI/CD workflows. You will work closely with data scientists, AI engineers, and IT teams to enable seamless, secure, and scalable AI/ML operations. We would expect 2-4  years professional experience in this role.


Project Description:

  • Develop and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML workflows.

  • Integrate security best practices across model development, training, and deployment phases.

  • Implement tools for monitoring and securing AI/ML infrastructure and data pipelines.

  • Conduct vulnerability assessments for AI models and infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with teams to ensure compliance with security and privacy standards.


Key Skills: 

  • Proficiency in CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab) and automation frameworks.

  • Strong knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience with MLOps frameworks (e.g., Kubeflow, MLflow) and securing ML pipelines.

  • Familiarity with AI-specific vulnerabilities (e.g., adversarial attacks, model poisoning) and mitigation techniques.

  • Expertise in infrastructure as code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and security compliance frameworks.


 

Benefits of working at Accenture:

·       18 weeks paid parental leave

·       Long & short-term career break opportunities

·       Structured career development program

·       Local and international career opportunities.

·       Certified as a Family Inclusive Workplace™

·       Flexible Work Arrangements - centered around Accenture’s Truly Human ethos and our commitment to supporting the health and wellbeing of our people.

·       We are proud to be in the top 3 of last year’s Diversity & Inclusion Index!


 

We are a WORK180 Endorsed Employer, to see our benefits and policies click here

All our consulting professionals receive comprehensive training covering business acumen, technical and professional skills development. You’ll also have opportunities to hone your functional skills and expertise in an area of specialization. We offer a variety of formal and informal training programs at every level to help you acquire and build specialized skills faster. Learning takes place both on the job and through formal training conducted online, in the classroom, or in collaboration with teammates. The sheer variety of work we do, and the experience it offers, provide an unbeatable platform from which to build a career. 

Accenture is a an EEO and Affirmative Action Employee of Females/Minorities/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities. 

 

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement for Australia and New Zealand:
 

At Accenture, our intention is to foster a culture and a workplace in which all of our people feel a sense of belonging and are respected and empowered to do their best work.
 

We encourage applications from all people with the relevant skillset, and we are committed to removing barriers to the recruitment process and employee lifecycle. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, disability status, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, religion or sexual orientation and we do not tolerate discrimination. If you require any accommodations or adjustments for interviews and/or at work, please reach out to exectalent@accenture.com or contact us at +61 2 9005 5000 (Australia) or +64 44666056 (New Zealand).
 

Learn how Accenture protects your personal data and know your rights in relation to your personal data. Read more about our Privacy Statement.

content.jobHook: At Medibank, we're passionate about creating the best health and wellbeing experiences for our customers and communities. As we continue to evolve...
content.unEditedContent:
You’re only human.   

It’s a strange thing to say, because us humans are capable of incredible things. And at Medibank, we know our greatest potential lies in the people who work with us.   

We strive to make real, fundamental change, driven by a simple purpose: to create the best health and wellbeing for all of Australia.  

Shape the Future of Data at Medibank

At Medibank, we're passionate about creating the best health and wellbeing experiences for our customers and communities. As we continue to evolve our enterprise data and AI capabilities, we're looking for an exceptional Principal Data Engineer to lead the technical vision and engineering excellence of our next-generation data platforms.

This is a rare opportunity for a highly experienced data engineering leader. You will drive innovation across cloud-native data platforms, Databricks, AI/ML enablement, and DataOps practices while mentoring and uplifting engineering teams across the organisation.

The Opportunity

As our Principal Data Engineer, you will define and lead the technical strategy, architecture, standards, and delivery of Medibank's enterprise data platforms.

Operating at the intersection of strategy and hands-on engineering, you'll partner with architects, engineers, data scientists, and business leaders to design robust, scalable, and secure data solutions that power analytics, machine learning, and customer experiences across the enterprise.

You'll be a thought leader, mentor, innovator, and trusted advisor, helping engineering teams adopt modern platform practices and engineering excellence.

What You'll Be Doing

Technology Leadership

  • Define and drive the technical roadmap for Medibank's Databricks platform, enterprise data pipelines, and AI/ML capabilities.
  • Provide strategic technical leadership across data engineering, analytics, DataOps, and AI/ML platform initiatives.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to innovate across data, cloud, and AI ecosystems.
  • Act as a senior technical advisor to engineering leaders, architects, and business stakeholders.
  • Establish engineering standards, frameworks, and best practices that scale across the organisation.
  • Mentor and coach engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and technical excellence.

Solution Design & Delivery

  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable lakehouse architectures and enterprise-grade data platforms using Databricks.
  • Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, libraries, and reference implementations to improve delivery velocity.
  • Partner with Engineering Leads and Data Architects to solve complex business challenges through data-driven solutions.
  • Guide teams on:
    • Data modelling and architecture patterns
    • Data quality frameworks
    • Pipeline orchestration
    • Metadata management
    • AI/ML lifecycle management
  • Facilitate technical workshops, platform onboarding sessions, and capability uplift across multiple delivery squads.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Platform Excellence & Support

  • Contribute to and help lead a Data Platform Centre of Excellence (CoE).
  • Provide hands-on technical expertise across multiple programs and initiatives.
  • Support and coordinate engineering delivery across globally distributed and offshore teams.
  • Promote consistency, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all platform capabilities.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Champion modern DataOps and MLOps practices, including:
    • CI/CD for data and machine learning
    • Automated testing
    • Data lineage
    • Platform observability and monitoring
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce technical debt and improve engineering productivity.
  • Develop tools and automation capabilities that streamline the development and deployment of data products.
  • Influence the adoption of modern cloud-native and AI-enabled engineering practices.

About You

Essential Experience & Skills

Databricks & Data Engineering

  • Expert-level experience with Databricks, including:
    • Delta Lake
    • Unity Catalog
    • MLflow
    • Databricks SQL
  • Advanced expertise in PySpark, Spark SQL, and distributed data processing.
  • Strong experience designing and implementing modern lakehouse architectures.
  • Deep knowledge of data modelling methodologies, including dimensional modelling, Data Vault, and feature store design.
  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Databricks Workflows, or Azure Data Factory.

AI/ML Platform Engineering

  • Proven experience enabling machine learning workloads at enterprise scale.
  • Experience building feature pipelines, model training pipelines, and model deployment frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of MLOps practices, including:
    • Model monitoring
    • Automated retraining
    • CI/CD for ML
    • Model governance
  • Experience partnering with Data Scientists to productionise machine learning models.

DataOps & Cloud Engineering

  • Strong experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM/Bicep, or CloudFormation).
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, security, and compliance controls.

General Engineering

  • Advanced programming skills in Python and SQL.
  • Experience working with REST APIs, event streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis), and microservices architectures.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience leading engineering teams across multiple regions and geographies.
  • Experience with real-time analytics and streaming AI/ML workloads.
  • Exposure to advanced optimisation techniques and modern AI engineering practices.
  • Experience with BI and analytics tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Experience with Azure services including ADLS, Synapse, Event Hub, and Key Vault.
  • Experience with data quality frameworks.
  • Databricks and/or AWS cloud certifications.

Experience Required

  • 10+ years' experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years working with Databricks or large-scale Spark platforms.
  • 5+ years designing and delivering cloud-native data solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy and influencing enterprise architecture decisions.

Imagine working with us 

We understand that work means different things to everyone...  We know happy, healthy people make great teams, and great teams put more heart into each customer and patient interaction. And that’s why we’re reinventing work.    

Imagine a workplace that helps you and your family thrive.  Where connection, personal development and health and wellbeing are front of mind. To learn more about our benefits go to https://careers.medibank.com.au/culture/rewards-benefits/

For you, work should help you Live Better. It should bring you fulfillment and joy. And with Medibank, it could. 

Inclusion and Accessibility  

We believe in everyone's potential and strive to make Medibank inclusive for all because different perspectives make us better. sections: You’re only human.
It’s a strange thing to say, because us humans are capable of incredible things. And at Medibank, we know our greatest potential lies in the people who work with us.
We strive to make real, fundamental change, driven by a simple purpose: to create the best health and wellbeing for all of Australia.
Shape the Future of Data at Medibank

At Medibank, we're passionate about creating the best health and wellbeing experiences for our customers and communities. As we continue to evolve our enterprise data and AI capabilities, we're looking for an exceptional Principal Data Engineer to lead the technical vision and engineering excellence of our next-generation data platforms.

This is a rare opportunity for a highly experienced data engineering leader. You will drive innovation across cloud-native data platforms, Databricks, AI/ML enablement, and DataOps practices while mentoring and uplifting engineering teams across the organisation.
The Opportunity
As our Principal Data Engineer, you will define and lead the technical strategy, architecture, standards, and delivery of Medibank's enterprise data platforms.

Operating at the intersection of strategy and hands-on engineering, you'll partner with architects, engineers, data scientists, and business leaders to design robust, scalable, and secure data solutions that power analytics, machine learning, and customer experiences across the enterprise.
You'll be a thought leader, mentor, innovator, and trusted advisor, helping engineering teams adopt modern platform practices and engineering excellence.
What You'll Be Doing
Technology Leadership
Define and drive the technical roadmap for Medibank's Databricks platform, enterprise data pipelines, and AI/ML capabilities.
Provide strategic technical leadership across data engineering, analytics, DataOps, and AI/ML platform initiatives.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to innovate across data, cloud, and AI ecosystems.
Act as a senior technical advisor to engineering leaders, architects, and business stakeholders.
Establish engineering standards, frameworks, and best practices that scale across the organisation.
Mentor and coach engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and technical excellence.
Solution Design & Delivery
Lead the design and implementation of scalable lakehouse architectures and enterprise-grade data platforms using Databricks.
Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, libraries, and reference implementations to improve delivery velocity.
Partner with Engineering Leads and Data Architects to solve complex business challenges through data-driven solutions.
Guide teams on:
Data modelling and architecture patterns
Data quality frameworks
Pipeline orchestration
Metadata management
AI/ML lifecycle management
Facilitate technical workshops, platform onboarding sessions, and capability uplift across multiple delivery squads.
Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Platform Excellence & Support
Contribute to and help lead a Data Platform Centre of Excellence (CoE).
Provide hands-on technical expertise across multiple programs and initiatives.
Support and coordinate engineering delivery across globally distributed and offshore teams.
Promote consistency, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all platform capabilities.
Innovation & Continuous Improvement
Champion modern DataOps and MLOps practices, including:
CI/CD for data and machine learning
Automated testing
Data lineage
Platform observability and monitoring
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce technical debt and improve engineering productivity.
Develop tools and automation capabilities that streamline the development and deployment of data products.
Influence the adoption of modern cloud-native and AI-enabled engineering practices.
About You
Essential Experience & Skills
Databricks & Data Engineering
Expert-level experience with Databricks, including:
Delta Lake
Unity Catalog
MLflow
Databricks SQL
Advanced expertise in PySpark, Spark SQL, and distributed data processing.
Strong experience designing and implementing modern lakehouse architectures.
Deep knowledge of data modelling methodologies, including dimensional modelling, Data Vault, and feature store design.
Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Databricks Workflows, or Azure Data Factory.
AI/ML Platform Engineering
Proven experience enabling machine learning workloads at enterprise scale.
Experience building feature pipelines, model training pipelines, and model deployment frameworks.
Strong understanding of MLOps practices, including:
Model monitoring
Automated retraining
CI/CD for ML
Model governance
Experience partnering with Data Scientists to productionise machine learning models.
DataOps & Cloud Engineering
Strong experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM/Bicep, or CloudFormation).
Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, security, and compliance controls.
General Engineering
Advanced programming skills in Python and SQL.
Experience working with REST APIs, event streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis), and microservices architectures.
Highly Regarded
Experience leading engineering teams across multiple regions and geographies.
Experience with real-time analytics and streaming AI/ML workloads.
Exposure to advanced optimisation techniques and modern AI engineering practices.
Experience with BI and analytics tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with Azure services including ADLS, Synapse, Event Hub, and Key Vault.
Experience with data quality frameworks.
Databricks and/or AWS cloud certifications.
Experience Required
10+ years' experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years working with Databricks or large-scale Spark platforms.
5+ years designing and delivering cloud-native data solutions.
Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy and influencing enterprise architecture decisions.
Imagine working with us

We understand that work means different things to everyone...  We know happy, healthy people make great teams, and great teams put more heart into each customer and patient interaction. And that’s why we’re reinventing work.

Imagine a workplace that helps you and your family thrive.  Where connection, personal development and health and wellbeing are front of mind. To learn more about our benefits go to https://careers.medibank.com.au/culture/rewards-benefits/
For you, work should help you Live Better. It should bring you fulfillment and joy. And with Medibank, it could.

content.unEditedContent:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong.  Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Shaping the future of real estate for a better world 

 At JLL, we see a Brighter Way forward for our clients, our people, our planet, and our communities. With over 200 years of real estate experience, we are, and always have been, in continual pursuit of brighter ways of working. 

We bring to life a Brighter Way in all that we do by seeking better, smarter, more innovative ways of working. We approach our work in a warmer, more optimistic, and inclusive way. 

JLL is a global leader in helping clients envision where people will live, work, play, shop, and eat. 

What this opportunity involves:

This role will be responsible for systems administration of a maintenance management system, reporting, and facilities support for a distributed portfolio. Primary duties will include working with the Facility Management team to handle routine facility related operations, including creating, managing, and verifying work orders, managing and clearing work order flags, and proficient management / coordination of and with maintenance technicians and 3rd party providers.

Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Manage all outsourced service contracts, including inspections and quality management of service delivery.

  • Undertake comprehensive tendering procedures for all outsourced services.

  • Serve as the single point of management control for FM, including engineering and soft services at the site.

  • Ensure compliance with client policies and procedures.

  • Ensure compliance with JLL-client FM Operations Manual procedures.

  • Ensure compliance with contractual SLAs to meet KPI targets.

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable government regulations.

  • Act as the interface with client representatives and BMO.

  • Assist with the implementation of the preventive maintenance program.

  • Manage small projects, including MAC works, and liaise with the project team on large-scale projects to ensure seamless FM operations.

  • Carry out periodic FM inspections.

  • Ensure defects are identified, captured through the Help Desk, and actioned within agreed service levels.

  • Coordinate FM team self-performed works and vendor works on site.

  • Monitor the quality of works or goods received, liaising with RET, the site engineer, or technician as necessary, and reconcile works or goods received against POs where required.

  • Manage financial activities, including budget forecasting, billing, vendor payments, and budget management.

  • Respond to emergency incidents in accordance with Emergency Response Procedures.

  • Ensure the effective completion of all incident reports.

  • Support the compilation and delivery of appropriate weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reports to the client.

  • Chair local FM operations meetings and attend regional FM operations meetings.

  • Chair monthly vendor meetings.

  • Manage and update local issue and project trackers.

  • Ensure compliance with Jones Lang LaSalle minimum audit standards.

  • Manage end-user expectations.

  • Proactively identify and investigate potential cost-saving or value-added opportunities.

  • Liaise with the Regional Account Director, Regional Facilities Manager, and JLL local team for additional support, including HR, administration, project management, and benchmarking.

  • Act as delegate for the client’s FM stakeholder when required in their absence.

Sounds like you? We are looking for someone:

  • University degree, preferably in FM, BSE, or CRE.

  • 3-5 years of FM or BSE experience.

  • Strong interpersonal, decision-making, and people management skills.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Fluent spoken and written English.

  • IT literate.

Benefits:

  • Great employee discounts off fitness, wellbeing & other renowned brands

  • 18 weeks paid maternity leave 

  • Private Health Insurance Discounts

  • Active Social Club

  • Employee assistant program

  • Novated Lease for EV cars

  • Paid time off for volunteer work

  • Career Opportunities with Australia's #1 Commercial Real Estate firm

  • Premium offices

What you can expect from us:  

You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where the best inspire the best. Where like-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things. Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sight and imagine where JLL can take you. 

As an organisation, we don’t just accept that we are a place of many different people, but we embrace it, we celebrate it, and we proactively support the needs that difference brings. JLL is committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, age, sexual orientation or disability, and that is why, for more than a decade, we continue to rank among the World’s Most Ethical Companies. We are dedicated to offering veterans from all ranks and services a successful civilian career as they transition out of the military. We recognise and appreciate the skills acquired in their service careers as vital and transferable to our workforce. 

Interested candidates, please apply following the link below quoting job reference number ABREQ526482

Location:

On-site –Melbourne, VIC

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements.  We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

At JLL, we harness the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to efficiently accelerate meaningful connections between candidates and opportunities. Using AI capabilities, we analyze your application for relevant skills, experiences, and qualifications to generate valuable insights about how your unique profile aligns with the specific requirements of the role you're pursuing.

JLL Privacy Notice

Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL), together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading global provider of real estate and investment management services. We take our responsibility to protect the personal information provided to us seriously. Generally the personal information we collect from you are for the purposes of processing in connection with JLL’s recruitment process. We endeavour to keep your personal information secure with appropriate level of security and keep for as long as we need it for legitimate business or legal reasons. We will then delete it safely and securely.

For more information about how JLL processes your personal data, please view our Candidate Privacy Statement.

For additional details please see our career site pages for each country.

Jones Lang LaSalle (“JLL”) is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities.  If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process – including the online application and/or overall selection process –  you may email us at HRSCLeaves@jll.com. This email is only to request an accommodation. Please direct any other general recruiting inquiries to our Contact Us page > I want to work for JLL.
